shortDescription: Store more with more interior space with 26 cubic feet capacity refrigerator. Stock up on everything you need and enjoy more space for your family's favorite foods and drinks.

images.label: Freezer Drawer with Ice Maker Right Angle

features.text: The built-in icemaker automatically makes ice cubes, so that you always have ice on hand for those hot summer days or when entertaining at home.

LG's intelligent Smart Inverter Compressor adjusts cooling power based on the amount of food stored and the refrigerator's inside and outside temperature. LG confidently backs the Inverter Compressor with a 10-year limited warranty.

Stock-up and store everything you need. With a cavernous 26 cubic feet of space, this LG Bottom Mount refrigerator gives you ample space for all of your family’s favorite foods and keeps them conveniently organized within reach.

Max out your fit with our hybrid handle design for easy opening and premium style. Our new bar handle design is slightly contoured to comfortably fit your hand. Discreet pocket handle on the freezer drawer makes it easy to slide it open, even when fully loaded. Together, they create a sleek look that complements the flat panel design.
The Look You Love (Without the Fuss)

Now you can have all of the things you love about stainless, without the need for special cleaners or constant attention.  LG’s PrintProof™ finish resists fingerprints and smudges for a distinctive kitchen that handles real-life in style.
More Ice When You Need It
Still need more ice? Turn on IcePlus™ to kick ice production into high gear by automatically lowering freezer temperatures to the coldest setting for 24 hours.

The 2 crisper drawers gives you easy access to your fruits, vegetables and beverages. This refrigerator also features a full-width Glide N' Serve® pantry drawer, making it easy to find some space for all that food you want to keep fresh.
